name: Sri Lanka
tagline: Short-haul variety at a sensible cost per delegate
intro: A short flight for a country that packs beaches, hill country and heritage sites into distances you can actually cover in a four-night programme. Good value, and still unfamiliar enough to feel like a reward.
best_months: December to March for the west and south coasts
access: Direct flights from Delhi to Colombo, roughly three and a half hours.
highlights: Multi-centre itineraries work genuinely well — a coastal leg and a hill-country leg inside one short trip.
Costs land below Thailand and well below Singapore at a similar standard.
Strong for educational and cultural programmes as well as corporate reward trips.
planning_note: The island has two monsoons hitting opposite coasts at opposite times, so the route has to be chosen around the season rather than the other way round. Confirm the current entry requirements when you book — they have changed several times.
